title: Tax audit
covers: this year against earlier years, with flags
audit points and who clears them

steps.say: Work through an audit in {product}: is one needed, what moved against earlier years, GST against the books, the Form 3CD clauses and the Accounting Standards that apply, and the points still open.
Choose the client; the year is picked at the top.
From the turnover in the mapped books: above 1 crore for a business, 10 crore when cash is within 5%, 50 lakh for a profession, or presumptive with a lower profit. Tick what the books cannot show.

Every mapped P&L and balance-sheet line against last year and up to four years before - from each year's statements, its filed return, or this year's previous-year column. Sharp moves are flagged, and so is a line that breaks its own history while turnover does not.
One click turns a flagged line into an audit point.

Add the GSTR-3B and GSTR-1 JSON from the GST portal - or the zip it downloads as. Month by month GSTR-3B against GSTR-1, and the year against the turnover in the books; a difference becomes an audit point.

Only the clauses that apply to this client, the riskiest first: pick the line of business, and clauses watching a flagged line rise to the top. Mark each one with a note; an issue opens an audit point.

For a firm, LLP, AOP or proprietor: whether an LLP's accounts must be audited, the ICAI level from turnover and borrowings, and the Accounting Standards that apply at that level - each worked through like a clause.
What still needs an answer before the report is signed, each with who answers it. A preparer raises points; a reviewer, auditor, partner or firm admin clears them.
